subject: sem(), non-specified correlation in my model

messages.author: d1b250b06cbb36a6
messages.subject: sem(), non-specified correlation in my model
parts:
I'm using the sem() function for my model.
I'm specifying various regressions ("~") and a few correlations (" ~~ ").
However, there is one extra correlation showing in the output that I did not specify in my model ("F1~~F2").

Why is lavaan automatically adding this one correlation?

Thanks ahead of time! Wellington.

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: sem(), non-specified correlation in my model
parts:
You don't describe the roles of the two factors in the model. If they are two dependents with no relation, the seem or cfa but not lavaan functions will add a residual covariance. You can force that to 0 with a line of code:
F1~~0*F2
